responsibility: This generator extracts all C conditions attached to machine-description patterns, evaluates which ones are compile-time constants, and emits a generated program that can write those results back as a define_conditions form for downstream generators. Its output embeds the condition strings, their constant truth values when available, and enough target-header context to compile the expressions safely, enabling gensupport and related tools to elide permanently-false patterns and to reason about MD conditions without reparsing target code at runtime.
